name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.24: allow-list set_payment_port so the Nayax serial port can be tried from the dashboard instead of one rebuild and one site visit per candidate. Validates the shape as /dev/ttySn, and refuses a port that collides with the machines own configured bus rather than hardcoding a rule: pointing the payment link at the bus a machine already uses would open a second reader and corrupt weights and payment at once, and a fixed ttyS3 rule would be wrong on coil where that is the motor bus rather than a free port. The refusal names which bus it collided with. Cumulative over v6.23.
